name: mysql-readonly-mcp

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Lists all tables in a database with their type (BASE TABLE or VIEW), row count estimate, and storage engine.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Returns detailed schema information for a table including columns (name, type, nullable, default, extra), primary key, foreign keys, and indexes.

table.description: Name of the table to describe.

tools.name: preview_data
tools.description: Previews table data with optional column selection, WHERE clause filtering, and automatic text truncation for long fields (>200 chars).

table.description: Name of the table to preview.

columns.description: Specific columns to return. Returns all columns if not specified.

where.description: Optional basic filter expression (without the WHERE keyword). Use run_query for complex SQL.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Executes a custom SELECT query with validation. Only SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, and EXPLAIN statements are allowed. Results are limited and execution time is tracked.

query.description: SQL query to execute. Must be a read-only query (SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN).

tools.name: show_relations
tools.description: Shows all foreign key relationships for a table, including tables that reference this table and tables this table references, with relationship type (one-to-one or one-to-many).

table.description: Name of the table to show relationships for.

tools.name: db_stats
tools.description: Returns database statistics including total table count, total row count estimate, database size, and top 10 largest tables by rows and by size.
